pages.text: Open a poster and press $(l)ACCEPT THIS BOUNTY$(). Its notes appear, and the kill is yours to make. You can hold five at once and drop one with $(l)ABANDON$().$(br2)You cannot hunt yourself, your own bounty, a teammate or an ally.

Your own hit counts, and so do your arrows, tridents and other shots. A fall, lava, fire or the void counts too if you hit them in the 5 seconds before and no mob hit them since.$(br2)A mob's blow never counts, nor do your tamed wolf, TNT or a machine.
pages.title: The kill

pages.text: One kill pays every bounty you accepted on that player, with the bonus if it came in time. Other hunters' bounties on them stay up.$(br2)Pieces go straight to your bank. Coins wait in your $(l)Collect$() box: a Bounty Board offers them to you as soon as you open it, and a Trade Post's COLLECT has them too.
